groups.defect: When credential sync is on (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are set), refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response. Callers expect their old return shape: Google and Zoho read `.data`, and HubSpot treats the result as a token. So the refresh breaks: it throws a TypeError or stores the Response as the credential key.

answer.reasoning:
All four suggestions report one defect. When sync is enabled, refreshOAuthTokens returns an unparsed fetch Response, but callers expect a parsed shape: a `.data` property or a token object.

- s_3736b761 points at the helper and lists the Google, HubSpot and Zoho callers.
- s_822cc0f9 points at the Google caller but lists the same callers.
- s_5ff676b6 and s_c16247ca cover only the Google caller, which is part of the same defect.

One fix resolves all of them: normalize the return value inside the helper. The members point at different files (the helper vs. the Google caller), so the kind is cross_location.

needsUnifiedComment is false. s_3736b761 and s_822cc0f9 each already cover the whole defect and every affected caller, so a merged comment would need nothing beyond either of them. That also matches the fix both suggest: one change in the helper. This point is a judgment call; the grouping itself is not.
